gameDescriptionHtml:
‘BEYBLADE X XONE is a “Beyblade action” game that faithfully recreates the BEYBLADE X series (distributed by TOMY Company, Ltd.) that is popular among fans of all ages. Battle through intense Beybattles and aim for the top of The X!

Experience action-packed Beyblade battles in a stadium equipped with BEYBLADE X’s signature X-celerator Rail as you unleash the Xtreme Dash and use the game’s original “Active Gauge” to execute exciting tactical maneuvers!

Game Features

  • STORY – A completely new story featuring original game characters! A new tournament, The X Championship, is being held at The X. Compete with rivals, deepen bonds, and aim for the top of The X!
  • BATTLE – Completely recreates the ultra-accelerated battles of BEYBLADE X! Feel the impact of extreme acceleration in a stadium equipped with the X-celerator Rail. When you “Let it rip!”, the “Active Gauge” fills over time. Use it to unleash critical “Attacks” and “Counters” one after another! Unleashing critical attacks increases the X Gauge! When it reaches MAX, choose the skill you want to activate. Skills operate on a rock-paper-scissors system. Choose a skill that gives you an advantage over your opponent! When you win, activate the skill and knock your opponent out in spectacular fashion!
  • CUSTOMIZE – Customization takes X Skills into account and offers over 100 million possible combinations! Freely combine parts and skills to set up your Beyblade just the way you want.
  • ONLINE BATTLES – In online battles, you can compete against Bladers from all corners of the globe anytime, anywhere! Challenge Bladers from around the world and aim for the top. (*The ranking specifications may differ slightly from other platforms.)
  • DOWNLOADABLE CONTENT – Additional Beyblades will be gradually released as downloadable content!
